name: gap_fade_reversion_v116
mechanism: When NIFTY gaps down >0.5% overnight, the first 5-10 minutes involve chaotic two-way flow as trapped overnight longs and opportunistic gap-extenders compete. Once NIFTY prints a 1-minute reversal candle — close in the upper 40% of its 1-minute high-low range and net positive over that minute — it signals that sell-at-open flows have been absorbed: VWAP-benchmarked institutional buyers, who are getting fills well below yesterday's close, have stepped in and overwhelmed the sellers. At 5-second resolution, we can detect this absorption signature (close-above-midrange + net 1-min gain) approximately 15-30 seconds before the bulk of the gap-fade impulse, entering with directional confirmation rather than blindly fading at open.
core_signal_oneliner: Gap > 0.5% day: confirmed 1-minute reversal candle (net positive return + close in upper 40% of 1-min range) signals institutional absorption complete
